content_data.project_description: Complete visual and interaction redesign of the player character customization system to enhance user engagement and align with evolving brand standards. This project addresses current usability pain points while introducing modern design patterns that support accessibility compliance.
content_data.timeline: 7 months with Phase 1: Discovery & Concepting (months 1-2), Phase 2: Design Development (months 3-5), Phase 3: Implementation Support & QA (months 6-7)
objectives: Modernize the character customization interface to improve player satisfaction scores
Establish scalable design system components for future character content
Reduce average customization time while increasing feature discovery
Ensure full WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for accessibility standards
deliverables: Accessibility compliance documentation and testing reports
User testing reports with iteration recommendations
Design handoff package with developer annotations and asset files
Complete UI/UX design system with component library
High-fidelity interactive prototypes for desktop and console platforms
technical_specs: Color specifications in HEX, RGB, and HSL with contrast ratios documented
Minimum touch target size of 44x44px for accessibility compliance
Animation specifications at 60fps with easing curve definitions
Design files in Figma with developer handoff mode enabled
Asset delivery in PNG, SVG, and vector formats with organized naming conventions
Maximum texture atlas size of 2048x2048 for UI sprite sheets
UI elements designed on 8px grid system for responsive scaling
content_data.design_style: Contemporary minimalist interface with vibrant accent colors, featuring smooth transitions and particle effects that complement the game's fantasy aesthetic while maintaining clarity and accessibility
